## Projects

- [APB memory: design and UVM verification](https://github.com/mirzamalikbaig/apb_uvm): AMBA APB memory slave with a UVM environment that has a directed sequence, a reference-memory scoreboard, and functional coverage. Run in Synopsys VCS.
- [AXI4 memory: UVM verification environment](https://github.com/mirzamalikbaig/axi4_uvm): UVM environment for a memory-mapped AXI4 slave covering all five channels. The recorded VCS run reached 98.15% functional coverage with 0 UVM errors across 12 directed scenarios.
- [Asynchronous FIFO](https://github.com/mirzamalikbaig/async_fifo): 16-entry, 8-bit FIFO with separate read and write clocks, Gray-coded pointers, and two-flop synchronizers. Checked with a scoreboard, six SVA checks, and seven directed tests in Verilator. A learning project.
- [Synchronous memory testbench](https://github.com/mirzamalikbaig/memory_verification): class-based SystemVerilog testbench for a synchronous memory with generator, driver, monitor, scoreboard, and coverage.
